original_target.title: Freeness of real hyperplane arrangements from their intersection lattice

scope_comparison: The new theorem treats at most16 central complex planes in dimension3, not all real arrangements. Conic-plus-lines examples compare weaker combinatorial counts and other examples have two nonfree arrangements distinguished by minimal Jacobian relations; neither is a real free/nonfree pair with identical full intersection lattice.
